name: Greyoak House
summary: An old house at the blind end of Fog Lane; three nights ago its master went in through this door and never came out. One night of percentile-dice mystery and dread.

opening_scene.en: The fog has crept all the way from the mouth of the lane to the steps of Greyoak House. A single oil lamp burns in the entrance hall. Oswin the butler stands in its shadow, a ring of keys clenched in his fist, with no sign of handing them to you. Winnie stands behind you and speaks very low: “My uncle went in through this very door three nights ago. He never came out.” Upstairs, the study door stands ajar; from the direction of the back garden comes the knock of a loose board in the wind.

en: Go upstairs and look in the study
@Oswin What has happened these three days?
/Listen Make out what is knocking in the back garden

world_info.tone: Cold, quiet, restrained; the dread comes only from details that are wrong, never from monsters

agent_routing.note: Every player input goes through the orchestrator first.
